description: Reports a telemetry event (run/complete/fail/ok/pause) for a monitor — records job/heartbeat activity and can clear or trigger alerts. Cronitor telemetry: GET {telemetryUrl}/p/{apiKey}/{monitorKey}?state=...

message.description: Optional message attached to the event.

series.description: Optional series id to correlate run/complete pings.

state.description: Telemetry state: run | complete | fail | ok | pause.

name: cronitor_ping_monitor
title: Ping monitor (telemetry)
